summary: The matrix, multilinear and PiTensorProduct layers sit at the natural level with no unused or over-strong hypotheses. Three representation-theory facts are pinned to special cases: the new group-algebra range lemma is restricted to `Module.End` although nothing about endomorphisms is used, and two general commutant arguments are re-proved inline for GL under `Field`/`Infinite`/`NeZero (d !)`.
